title: Preservation under an interior update
statement: Let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ and let $a,n,b,m,c\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose $\mu$ and $\mu'$ agree at every natural number that lies outside both intervals $[a,a+n)$ and $[b,b+m)$, and suppose $c$ lies in at least one of those intervals. Then replacing the value of $\mu'$ at $c$ by any integer $x$ preserves its agreement with $\mu$ outside both intervals.
hypotheses_covered: Agreement wherever the index is outside both intervals
The updated index lies in at least one interval
